Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular silhouettes are the Tunic Dress and the Shift Dress.
• Flora Embroidered Sleeveless Tunic Dress ($128): Offers a slightly longer cut (around 35" in length) with intricate collar embroidery and a relaxed silhouette that effortlessly goes from beach to street.
• Tideglass Sleeveless Shift Dress ($124): Features a classic shift cut (around 34.5" in length) with a clean, flattering fit and side pockets for everyday convenience.
Both options feature lightweight, wrinkle-resistant UPF 50+ fabric. If you prefer a classic straight fit with pockets for easy daily wear, the Shift Dress is a fantastic pick. If you love subtle embroidered details and a slightly longer tunic length, the Tunic Dress is ideal.
